summary.text: Manny Cruz is a Democratic state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 7th Essex District since January 4, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Salem native with a political science degree from Northeastern University, he previously served on the Salem School Committee and worked in education advocacy and legislative offices.

paragraphs.text: Manny Cruz was born in Salem, Massachusetts, graduated from Salem High School, and earned a B.S. in political science and government from Northeastern University in 2016.

His career experience includes working as advocacy director of Latinos for Education Massachusetts, district director for State Representative Paul Tucker, a legislative aide to State Representative Juana Matias, and a national park service ranger at the Salem Maritime National Historic Site.

He has served on the Salem School Committee, on the boards of LEAP For Education, Plummer Youth Promise and the North Shore Community Actions Program, and as a founding board member and secretary of the MA Alliance for Early College.

Cruz succeeded Paul Tucker in the 7th Essex District seat, and for 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the House Ways and Means Committee and the Cannabis Policy, Education, Economic Development and Emerging Technologies, and Ways and Means joint committees.
